title: Consumption Engine decision ledger, public export
export_rules: Fields kept verbatim: id, node, question, evidence, decision, check, bar, judge_at, status, outcome, resolved_at.
engine_lookups replaced by engine_lookup_count (the lookup query log is internal).
Local filesystem paths (drive letters, home-directory paths) replaced with <private-path>; 9 occurrences (drive-letter, home-directory and absolute Unix paths).
source_row_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the exact original ledger line, so a later audit can bind each public row to its private original.
